messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Steamless the first age before the engine when rivers carried cloth and bells marked the hours and fields waited upon the rain and every city rose upon the wind and each promise closed Steamless
Wind the second age of sails and mills where towers caught the gale and scholars wrote on bark and maps grew with the tides and every journey began upon the Wind
Hand the third age of makers who shaped bronze and glass and bone and built bridges of rope and wood and measured time by the turning of the sky and every craft returned to Hand
River the fourth age when canals stitched the valleys together and barges carried grain and song and children learned to read by the light of oil and each season followed the River
Lantern the fifth age of quiet cities where light was kept in glass shells and streets hummed with music instead of machinery and dreams floated over the rooftops and the world slept beneath the Lantern
